title: Triggering conversion in vanadium electrodes
authors: Stefan A. Freunberger
abstract: Published online: 26 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41563-026-02714-3 Using transition metals efficiently in aqueous batteries requires transferring multiple electrons per metal, which leads to difficult-to-manage conversion reactions. It is now shown how vanadium can be changed from one-electron insertion to four-electron conversion.

abstract: Published online: 26 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41563-026-02729-w The kinetics and thermodynamics of void formation are investigated in <mark>all-solid-state</mark> <mark>lithium</mark> metal batteries and found to be controlled by interfacial <mark>lithium</mark> concentration and diffusivity.
